# Mann Dev

> Custom websites and web apps built from scratch in Montréal. No templates, no page builders — just clean, fast code you own outright.

Mann Dev is a web design and development studio founded by Julien Mann, based in Montréal, Québec, working remotely worldwide. Every project is hand-coded — no templates, no page builders — with a focus on performance, accessibility, and code the client owns outright.

## Services

- [Landing Page](https://manndev.com/#services): A single, focused page built to convert. Custom design, fully responsive, deployed within a few days.
- [Full Website](https://manndev.com/#services): Multi-page site covering about, services, portfolio, and contact. Custom design system, CMS integration if needed.
- [Care & Hosting](https://manndev.com/#services): Flat monthly rate for managed hosting, uptime monitoring, security patches, and ongoing support.
- [AI Automation](https://manndev.com/#services): Custom AI-powered workflows, chatbots, and automations built into existing tools or as standalone systems.

## Contact

## Insights

- [Insights](https://manndev.com/blog/): Guides on web design, performance, accessibility and SEO for small business owners.
- [Core Web Vitals, explained for business owners](https://manndev.com/blog/core-web-vitals-explained/): LCP, INP and CLS in plain language: what Google's three Core Web Vitals measure, what a good score looks like, how to check your own site in five minutes, and what usually fixes a bad one.
- [Custom website or website builder? An honest comparison](https://manndev.com/blog/custom-website-vs-website-builder/): Wix, Squarespace and Shopify are real options for a small business. Here is what a custom-built site gives you that a builder doesn't, what it costs you, and how to tell which one you need.
- [Local SEO for small business websites: the basics that move the needle](https://manndev.com/blog/local-seo-for-small-business-websites/): How local customers find businesses on Google, and the handful of things that actually help you show up: your Google Business Profile, consistent details, real service pages, reviews, and a site that's fast and bilingual where it needs to be.
- [Website accessibility for small businesses: a practical WCAG 2.2 checklist](https://manndev.com/blog/website-accessibility-checklist/): What WCAG 2.2 AA means in plain language, why it matters for a small business website, and a twelve-point checklist you can run on your own site this afternoon.
